title: back-up alarm (hyphen)
text: A haul truck at the surface pit was observed operating with an inoperative back-up alarm.

title: backup alarm (one word)
text: A haul truck at the surface pit was observed operating with an inoperative backup alarm.

title: reverse alarm (no 'back')
text: A haul truck at the surface pit was observed operating with an inoperative reverse signal alarm.

title: back-up alarm + explicit surface mine words
text: A haul truck at the surface metal and nonmetal mine haul road was observed operating with an inoperative back-up alarm.

title: underground coal conveyor guard
text: In the underground coal mine, the conveyor belt drive was operating with the guard removed near the tailpiece where miners travel.
